summary: Seer, Inc. filed an 8-K confirming receipt of two revised unsolicited, non-binding acquisition proposals to acquire all outstanding Class A shares. The Radoff-JEC Group offered $2.55 per share in cash plus a contingent value right on July 28, 2026; CEO Omid Farokhzad offered $2.45 per share in cash plus two CVRs on July 29, 2026. Farokhzad's proposal was delivered to a Special Committee. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The transaction is at proposal stage, non-binding; stockholders need take no action now. Watch for Special Committee negotiations, potential competing bids, and deal terms evolution.
